Create your own worktree: ../ysamet-llm on branch codex/fresh-llm from origin/main.

GOAL
Add a narrow, safe LLM layer where judgment helps and arithmetic risk is zero. Smoke-test it locally, then run it on one case where it should matter, and iterate.

WHY
- Every measured supplier move so far came from structured inputs: verified claims and terms.
- But our message bodies are 100% templates. They ignored supplier questions like "which volume can you commit to?" about 35 times, and "which figures is that based on?" (P05, P03).
- Trait detection uses regexes on the exact practice-note phrasing. On Sunday a new data release arrives, and the Live Final uses unseen suppliers, so the regexes will silently miss new wording.

SCOPE, in priority order
1. LLM trait extraction (highest transfer value).
   - From supplier notes, letters and replies, return [{trait, quote}], e.g. wants_fast_payment, cash_short, capacity_idle, pricing_committee, multi_year_preference.
   - Validate that every quote appears verbatim in the source; otherwise drop it.
   - Merge the result with the regex traits. It's interpretation only.
   - Opt-in config field: model_traits.
2. LLM option choice.
   - Code computes 2–4 legal, code-priced candidate packages per turn (existing ones: hold, payment trade, chargeback/value swap, standard step).
   - The LLM reads the thread and returns the index of the package to send, plus a one-line reason.
   - Fallback is today's deterministic choice.
   - It never invents a package, price or term.
   - Opt-in field: model_choice.
3. LLM-worded reply to supplier questions.
   - When the supplier asks a direct question (volume, figures, forecast, committee), the LLM writes 1–3 sentences answering it, using only facts from an allowlist the code provides: fixed volume, verified claim IDs/values, contract terms.
   - A validator rejects the text if any number or claim isn't in the allowlist, or if it mentions internal estimates, reservations or targets. On rejection, fall back to the template.
   - Opt-in field: model_answers.

HARD RULES
- Prices, terms, constraints, closing decisions and all arithmetic stay in code. The LLM interprets text and chooses among code-priced options only.
- Claims come only from public facts. Never leak internal numbers.
- The agent must never read /v1/events, /screen, /leaderboard or /results. Never use hidden c_best or back-solved score breakdowns.
- Never counter a supplier's final offer. All 3 past attempts made the supplier walk away.
- Set timeouts: if the LLM call fails or exceeds about 8s, fall back deterministically. A session timeout scores 0.
- New features are opt-in config fields with tests, and ruff must be clean.

SETUP CHECKS (do these first, 0 sessions)
- Confirm LLM_PROVIDER, LLM_MODEL, LLM_EFFORT, LLM_BASE_URL and LLM_API_KEY load from the ignored .env. Print only the names and the first 4 characters, never the key.
- Find the existing model-assist code (grep model_assist / LLM_ in src/negotiator) and reuse it.
- `negotiator lab run` exports ARENA_DATA from --data and fails without it. Still check that claims appear in the transcripts.
- Read LAB_PLAYBOOK.md and the relevant parts of experiments/LOG.md: P07, P10, P05 and P03 transcripts, especially the supplier questions we ignored.

SMOKE TESTS (0 practice sessions)
1. Unit tests:
   - the quote validator rejects fabricated quotes;
   - the answer validator rejects unknown numbers and internal values;
   - timeouts and failures fall back deterministically.
2. Offline replay over saved transcripts for all ten cases:

3. Free sandbox D01/D02, with configs/fresh-llm.json = score-push-v3.json + the new flags. It must not regress (D01 .9192, D02 .5239).
   Report latency per turn.

HOSTED RUNS
- Hard cap: 4 practice sessions.
- Target P07 first (.7600, best team .82). The supplier asks "which volume can you commit to?" and goes final at its 4th reply, so a real answer plus a better option choice could matter.
- If P07 wins, repeat it once. If it doesn't, try P10 (.6551, best .74; the LLM already picks its packages).
- Before each run, write down what differs from previous attempts and why it could work.
- Read the full transcript after each run.
- Log each run in experiments/LOG.md, then run lab sync and push your branch.
- Merge nothing to main: only n=2 winners go to main, and only via the team's final ten-case confirmation on Sunday.

- each run: run id, score, and why it won or lost, with transcript quotes
- sessions used
- what to try next

2. Cost-breakdown request (the pacing agent's). FYI only.
3. Supplier value model (yours).
   - beliefs.py is an unimplemented stub (prior and update raise NotImplementedError). It was meant to learn how much each supplier values each field from its answers to our 2–3 term sheets. The brief's tip is to send 2–3 term sheets to see what a supplier values.
   - Fold this into your option-choice feature: track which sheet the supplier answered and how its counter moved per field, and feed that summary to the LLM when it chooses among code-priced options.
   - Keep it deterministic where possible.
4. Citing lower quotes (the pacing agent's). FYI only.
5. Tone and supplier questions (yours).
   - The brief says replies are "understood – and have consequences": questions, appreciation and relationship matter, padding does not.
   - This backs your validated answers to supplier questions. Keep them short and polite, answer the question, and never pad.

Hard requirement (Live Final): every wave has an 8-minute cap. Threads still open at the cap end with no deal.
- Every LLM call needs a timeout of about 8 s, with a deterministic fallback.
- Log the latency of each call.

input.plan:
# LLM layer + wave-cap guard (codex/fresh-llm)

## Setup findings (done, 0 sessions)
- Worktree `../ysamet-llm` on `codex/fresh-llm` created from `origin/main` (`ddf0bb2`; negotiator src unchanged since `a655f3d`). `.env` copied (ignored); `data/` symlinked to the main checkout; `ARENA_DATA` fixed (old value pointed to a missing dir).
- Env loads: `LLM_PROVIDER=open…`, `LLM_MODEL=gpt-…`, `LLM_EFFORT=low`, `LLM_BASE_URL=http…`, `LLM_API_KEY` set (164 chars). Probe: strict-JSON call 3.4–4.4 s; 8 s timeout is right.
- Existing model code to reuse: `package_advisor.py` (`complete`, `bounded_call`, strict `json_schema`, `reasoning_effort`, cache, final cost re-check) and `model_assist.py` (verbatim-quote checks). `beliefs.py` is a stub; `evaluator.revealed_deltas` already extracts per-field price deltas from supplier sheets.
- Transcripts read (run `6b162c54`, archive `ysamet-run-archive/ysamet-integrate`): P07 supplier asks "Which volume can you commit to?" every reply and "Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data." at reply 3 (unanswered); P03 asks the same "figures" question at reply 1 (unanswered); P07's volume question is already answered by `bundle_commitment_types` (.7600 ×2). No back-office data exists locally.
- Time limits: `arena_kit.play.MOVE_LIMIT_S=60`, `CLOSE_BEFORE_CAP_S=90`, `ROUND_MARGIN_S=15`; both runners already close accept-or-walk at `cap - max(90, slowest_round+15)`; the agent itself never sees the wave cap.

## 1. Shared LLM client + time budget — new `src/negotiator/llm.py`
- `LlmClient.call(kind, system, payload, schema, timeout_s=8)` over `LLM_BASE_URL/LLM_API_KEY/LLM_MODEL/LLM_EFFORT`, reusing `package_advisor.bounded_call`; records per-call `{kind, elapsed_s, ok, error_type}`; never raises past the caller's fallback.
- `TurnBudget`: per decision, LLM total ≤ ~18 s and each call is skipped when the thread window (`trades.deadlines[sid]`) or the wave remaining is too low. Every skipped/failed call logs a `model_fallback` decision record.
- `PackageAgent.experiment_metrics()` adds `llm` metrics (calls, fallbacks, latency list, tokens) alongside the existing `model` block.

## 2. `model_traits` — new `src/negotiator/llm_traits.py`
- Vocabulary = `traits.NOTE_TRAITS` keys + `cash_short`, `multi_year_preference` (+ aliases e.g. `capacity_idle→idle_capacity`, `fast_payment→wants_fast_payment`). Add `cash_short` to `traits.CASH_SHORT`.
- `extract(sources=[{id,text}])` → `[{trait, quote, source}]`; drop any item whose quote is not a verbatim substring of its source (exact, else whitespace-normalised), trait outside the vocabulary, or quote < 8 chars.
- Sources: `dossier.notes` (notes, letters, e-mails) once per supplier (cached) + each new supplier reply body (cached by message index).
- Merge = union with regex traits, in one place: `PackageAgent._public_traits(sid, case)`, the dossier copy passed to `bundle_volume.plan/committee_threshold` in `_bundle_volume`, and `TradePolicy.traits[sid]` after `prepare`. Trace `model_traits` with quotes. Interpretation only.

## 3. `model_choice` + deterministic supplier-value summary — new `src/negotiator/llm_choice.py`, fill `beliefs.py`
- `beliefs.update(case, events, std)`: deterministic, from the thread only — which of our sheets the supplier priced/answered, its price move per round, `revealed_deltas` per field (e.g. P07: 90d→30d = −0.07), fields it adopted/refused (contract_months accepted, payment refused…), status. Returns a small JSON summary; no NotImplementedError left.
- Candidates in `agent.decide_thread` just before the final `_offer` (open thread, `cap_c is None`, `moves_left > 1`, type not in `package_advice_types` to avoid double advice, never on final offers):
  - `step` = scheduled terms (default, index 0);
  - `hold` = our last sheet, only if the supplier's latest price did not move;
  - payment variants from `_payment_variants` (equal buyer C, code-priced);
  - one-field exchanges from `package_advisor.approved_packages` (≤ ceiling C).
  - Cap at 4; each re-checked with `must_haves_ok`, `complete_offer` no-snap and `total_cost ≤ C(step)+1e-7` before send. Value swap stays deterministic (P11 .8771 depends on it).
- LLM gets recent thread, candidates (id, label, terms), belief summary, public notes; returns `{index, reason}` (strict schema, integer enum). Invalid/timeout → index 0. Trace `model_choice` with reason and belief summary.

## 4. `model_answers` — new `src/negotiator/llm_answers.py`
- Detect direct questions in the latest supplier reply (`?` sentences with volume/commit/figure/data/based/forecast/committee/approval keywords).
- Allowlist built in code: offered terms, `case.fixed_terms`/`buyer.need_per_year`, bundle plan totals (`bundle_volume.plan`), committee threshold, supplier's own quoted figures, numbers/IDs already present in the thread (public), buyer `refs` already verified.
- Validator rejects: any number not in the allowlist (after thousands-separator normalisation; unit-bearing numbers — days/months/kits/pcs/EUR — must match offered/fixed terms), any ID not already cited, forbidden words (budget, target, reservation, estimate, internal, maximum, limit, ceiling, floor, alternative, rival, competitor, deadline, urgent, our calculation, margin…), `guards.leaks`, > 3 sentences / 450 chars, padding phrases. Tone rule in prompt: short, polite, answer the question, no padding.
- Integration in `propose()` after `_bundle_volume`/`_fast_payment_note`, before evidence: for bundling later rounds the template commitment paragraph becomes the fallback (`_bundle_volume` hands it over instead of appending); elsewhere a valid answer is appended, otherwise today's body is unchanged. First-round cited paragraphs (refs/claims) are never replaced.

## 5. Wave-cap guard + timing logs
- `PackageAgent.wave_deadline` (callable/float) set by `play.play_case` (serial) and `runner.CaseRunner` (async, from `_cap()`); `agent.round_time_s` fed from `slowest`/`st.slowest_round_s`.
- In `decide_thread`: `remaining = cap - now`; if `remaining < 2*max(round_time, 60)+15`: stop extending — send the convergence offer (`{**n, unit_price: p}`, "their price, our terms") when its C < `ref_c` and < `c_alt`, else return `{"close": True, "reason": "wave cap: converge"}` so the coordinator accepts the best standing sheet via `close_decision` (must-haves + alternative check) or walks. Never counter a final offer. Below ~1 round the existing runner close stays.
- Logs: serial `play_case` traces `round_time` per decision `{case, supplier, decide_s, llm_s, send_s, round_s}` and `thread_time` totals at case end; async `_worker` traces the same (`reply.round_s` exists). `lab` run.json `elapsed_s` per attempt already exists; add per-thread worst round to the summary printed by the offline tool.
- LLM calls honour `TurnBudget` (skip when thread window < 25 s or wave remaining < guard margin).

## 6. Config + tests
- `policy.py`: `model_traits`, `model_choice`, `model_answers` as case-type lists (same validation loop as other `*_types`); defaults off. `configs/fresh-llm.json` = `score-push-v3.json` + the three fields for all seven types.
- New tests (stub `complete_fn`, no network): fabricated quote dropped; answer validator rejects unknown numbers/internal words/IDs and accepts a valid P07 answer; choice falls back on timeout/garbage/out-of-range index and never changes a package's cost check; `beliefs.update` on the P07 thread; wave guard converges then closes with a fake clock; policy validation. `uv run --locked pytest -q`, `ruff check .` clean.

## 7. Offline replay — new `tools/llm_replay.py`
- Reads a `run.json` (v2-confirm `6b162c54`, all ten cases); per buyer turn prints extracted traits+quotes, belief summary, candidates and the LLM's pick+reason, drafted answers with validator verdict, and latency per call; asserts no leak/invented number. Standard terms re-derived from the "standard Zahlungsziel N days" phrase (attachments carry no text offline; noted as a limitation).

## 8. Sandbox + hosted runs (tracked `negotiator lab run`, `--data` exported)
- Free sandbox D01/D02 with `fresh-llm.json`, `--runner auto`; must hold .9192/.5239; report per-turn latency from the traces.
- Practice cap 4: P07 ×1 (hypothesis written in LOG before: answers the "which figures" question with cited facts, LLM may pick the 30-day variant the supplier priced cheaper, belief summary shows payment delta −0.07). Win (> .7600) → repeat once; lose → P10 ×1 (+ repeat if win). Read every transcript; LOG each run; `lab sync`; push branch. No main merge.
- Rehearsal (10 sessions, separately authorised): `negotiator run --set practice --runner auto --parallel 10` equivalent via lab (all P-cases ×1) with `fresh-llm.json`, wall-clock timed; report worst-case thread duration, slowest round, LLM latency histogram, any timeout.

## Push-backs / limits
- Supplier ladders so far tracked our step size, not wording (P07 schedule axis closed at .7145/.7145); expect text effects to be small; measured n=1 each.
- "Hold" is restricted to mirroring a supplier hold; value swap and final-offer paths stay out of LLM choice.
- Trait generalisation can only be checked on Sunday's release; the replay tool is the pre-check.
